tools.name: get_connected_profile
tools.description: Identify the Afterglow account connected for this conversation. Returns the account email and its actual verification state. Does not read your story or coaching history.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Show available items and saved progress in one of your Afterglow checklists. Use when you ask for unfinished legal, money, home or coparenting checklist tasks. Your account's current onboarding and plan limits apply. Keep the returned disclaimer intact.

tools.name: set_checklist_status
tools.description: Save done, to do or not applicable for the exact item ID the user selected from an Afterglow checklist. Obtain confirmation of the item and status before calling. Overwrites that item's existing progress in the connected account. Repeating the same item and status preserves the completed timestamp a

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "set_checklist_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Save done, to do or not applicable for the exact item ID the user selected from an Afterglow checklist. Obtain confirmation of the item and status before callin…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connected_profile · Public sink: get_connected_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connected_profile · Public sink: get_connected_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
